hebrewText: אֶֽל יִדְרֹ֤ךְ ידרך הַ/דֹּרֵךְ֙ קַשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֶל יִתְעַ֖ל בְּ/סִרְיֹנ֑/וֹ וְ/אַֽל תַּחְמְלוּ֙ אֶל בַּ֣חֻרֶ֔י/הָ הַחֲרִ֖ימוּ כָּל צְבָאָֽ/הּ

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string abow (by treading on it in bending)
tokens.kjv: archer, bend, come, draw, go (over), guide, lead (forth), thresh, tread (down), walk.
